settings.text: What is DHT?
settings.answer_content:
“Dihydrotestosterone (DHT) is a hormone derived from testosterone, which can contribute to hair loss and acne by shrinking hair follicles and stimulating excessive sebum production in the skin. This occurs because DHT binds to androgen receptors in the scalp and sebaceous glands.

Our DHT blocker uses a combination of vitamins, herbs, and botanical extracts, including saw palmetto and stinging nettle which support blocking the production of DHT.

This DHT blocking formula is rich in antioxidants, supports immune function, gut health, and overall body vitality.
